video_title: Rockets END Warriors Win Streak! How Far Will KD & Sengun take the Rockets??

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Durant's role and health are key to Rockets' success
quotes.excerpt: to be able to reserve him the way you are but still allow him to play at such an elite level, I think it's great for Houston
quotes.quote: This is a good-looking team and I love what they're doing regular season. Obviously Kevin Durant being at the age he's at, the stage he's at in his career, he's on the tail end of it. To be able to reserve him the way you are but still allow him to play at such an elite level, I think it's great for Houston, especially later on in the year. Come playoff time, one of the things that's held Kevin Durant back in recent years has been his health. So last year he missed out because of health. I think with what they're doing, it preserves him. He's going to be 100% healthy come playoff time and I think that's the best version of Kevin Durant you're going to get. We know he's going to arrive to the moment.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Alperen Sengun's growth as the engine of the Rockets
quotes.excerpt: Sengun is playing extremely high level basketball. You can say he's the engine as well with this group
quotes.quote: Sengun is playing extremely high level basketball. You can say he's the engine as well with this group. He's improved a lot since last year. A lot of the things that were a blemish towards his game, he's corrected. Playing defense, he's being a rim protector, he's attacking the rim, finishing strong. So a lot of things he's improved on and this is just a well-rounded team.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Fred VanVleet's arrival provides security and structure for Rockets
quotes.excerpt: the arrival of Fred VanVleet just gets their offense so much more secure
quotes.quote: The arrival of Fred VanVleet just gets their offense so much more secure. It gets them in their spaces. It allows Reed Sheppard to be Reed Sheppard, play off the ball. It allows Sengun to get play off the ball and movement and spacing when he gets the ball in the block. Kevin Durant obviously is going to score in any system, so that doesn't matter. But just having that floor general, that point guard who can make big shots, they're balanced. They're deep, they can beat you inside-out, they're a top 10 defensive team, they're a top 10 offensive team.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Rockets can win by committee without needing Alperen Sengun to be All-NBA
quotes.excerpt: this team can win by committee. They got a lot of different guys that can help them
quotes.quote: I don't think he has to be All-NBA level for this thing to get to where they want to go. I think he can just play his part and in any given night he can be the best player. I think what Tim Hardaway Jr. just said about Kevin Durant, he just plays the right way. He's had games this year where he was criticized for only taking five or six shot attempts, but that's what the game called for. I don't think he has to. This team can win by committee. They got a lot of different guys that can help them with production and winning basketball games.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Alperen Sengun is a three-level scorer but not yet a closer
quotes.excerpt: he hasn't marqued himself to be the guy that can finish games for them and that's Steph Curry
quotes.quote: Sengun is playing lights out as a rookie. Man, super impressed with what he's doing and the way that he carries himself, the way that he plays, his pace. Sometimes he brings the ball up, he can create off the dribble, you can throw it to him in the post, he's going to take advantage of his size. He's a three-level scorer at this point in his young career, but he hasn't marqued himself to be the guy that can finish games for them and that's Steph Curry.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Steph Curry's injury could send the Warriors into a losing streak
quotes.excerpt: if he was to go down, it's going to plummet the rest of the team
quotes.quote: This was kind of the writing on the wall, especially with how he's been playing. You have your oldest guy on the team, he's putting up historic numbers this late in his career. Obviously, if he was to go down, it's going to plummet the rest of the team. You just can't go find 30 to 35 points on the bench on a random night. It's going to be tough for the Warriors. This is part of the issue I had with how they built this team around him. Obviously, Jimmy Butler going down, that changes the whole look of his team, but I don't feel at this stage in his career he's supposed to have this much responsibility to carry his team every night.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors' offense relies heavily on Steph Curry's gravity and spacing
quotes.excerpt: the attention that he gets opens up the floor for the Yaxels and the Draymonds
quotes.quote: It's not even Steph's scoring and shooting. We know how great he is there. It's just the way that you approach the Warriors and defend the Warriors, it has a lot to do with Steph Curry and the double teams and the spacing and the attention that he gets opens up the floor for the Yaxels and the Draymonds and the Meltons. So they are going to have to face different coverages now without him on the floor with them, having all that attention towards him.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Yaxel has exceeded expectations despite being an older rookie
quotes.excerpt: he's picking battles with Luka. He's isoing Kevin Durant last night. You can just tell he's embracing these matchups
quotes.quote: I don't care if he's 30 years old, he's averaging 21, 7 and 4. So no matter what his age is, he's still really good at basketball and having a hell of a year. I don't care that he's an older rookie. He has exceeded expectations so much and he's tough, he's fearless. He's picking battles with Luka. He's isoing Kevin Durant last night. You can just tell he's embracing these matchups. Are they going to take a spill a little bit and might spiral? Yes, if Steph takes Steph Curry off any, takes Steph Curry off Team USA, we're going to struggle.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors need to survive the next six games to stay competitive
quotes.excerpt: if they can go four and two in their next six and buy them some time for Steph
quotes.quote: If they can buy some time with this schedule, they might be all right. If they can go four and two in their next six and buy them some time for Steph to get back, they might be all right.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Yaxel has the keys to the Warriors' offense without Steph Curry
quotes.excerpt: he's now at that point forward, he's going to run this offense without Steph Curry on the floor
quotes.quote: What an even more opportunity though for Yaxel with his rookie of the year push the way his season started. Now he's got the keys. He's now at that point forward, he's going to run this offense without Steph Curry on the floor. This is a great opportunity early in his career to have even more on his plate and expand that game. I think it's huge for him, but they're going to miss Steph Curry a lot.
